title: Campus Facilities | KPGU Vadodara
content: Admission Inquiry Campus Campus Facilities World-class infrastructure across 27 acres - designed to transform passion into profession. infrastructure Everything You Need to Thrive From modern labs and smart classrooms to a hospital, hostels, and a full-service bank - KPGU's campus is truly self-contained. Modern Departments & Laboratories Select Facility Gallery Research & Innovation Modern Departments & Laboratories KPGU, Vadodara offers cutting-edge facilities in the departments and laboratories for students to secure their future. In the short span, each department has specialized labs designed to meet the unique needs of various fields of study, from engineering and sciences to healthcare and technology. These spaces provide students with hands-on experience, enabling them to apply theoretical knowledge in practical scenarios. With modern instruments and facilities, the university makes students industry-ready through quality education so as to match with the pace of rapid technology advances. Key Highlights Modern instruments: GC, HPLC, FTIR, X-Ray Machine Ultra-modern facilities: PLC / CAD-CAM / MATLAB / FABLABS / High Voltage Lab / PSIM / PRO-E 10 dedicated computer labs with ~200 desktop computers Specialized labs for Engineering, Sciences, Healthcare & Technology CAMPUS LIFE A Campus Built for Your Success Krishna Edu Campus spreads over 27 acres of lush green surroundings. Every facility is designed to transform passion into profession. Admission Inquiry Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara. Approved by UGC, AICTE, PCI & AYUSH.
